title: Prose canon — Character (engine_data/people/*.json)
description: Sentient being living in the Characters repo (SS-LAW-4). Registers the existing on-disk shape; descriptive, not restrictive. id derived as character.<slug(name)>; on disk the row is keyed by filename + name.

age.description: One reference-point value for the whole series record, not per-book — a series can span years (BCODA ~2226, CYB1 ~2230) and the same character ages across it. A book-specific age belongs in the Story Ledger as an `age` claim scoped to that book (see docs/LEDGER.md), not here and not in `description` free text (SS-T17).
